meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary national jurisdiction; primary registry: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá D.C.)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic), unitary national regime, constitutionalized commercial legislation
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 15 May 2012)
Colombia–European Union Andean Trade Agreement (in force 1 August 2013)
Colombia–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force 17 March 2012)
Colombia–Chile DTAA and Alianza del Pacífico Framework Agreement (in force 2008 / 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF creation, AML/CFT institutional framework); Law 1121 of 2006 (money laundering and terrorist financing criminalization); Decree 1068 of 2015, amended (comprehensive AML/CFT rules, 'listas restrictivas' under Decree 1674 of 2016); Article 92 of Law 2155 of 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUBF); DIAN Resolution 000011 of 2023 (RUBF technical filing rules); Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. regime); SIC Circular 009 of 2021 (AML/CFT obligations for commercial registries and non-financial sectors); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular 100-000013 of 2022, updating SAGRILAFT (Sistema de Autocontrol y Gestión del Riesgo Integral de LA/FT/FPADM).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Legal Existence of foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of country of origin (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State, UK Companies House, EU commercial register)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization if origin is a non-Hague-Convention state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (poder especial) for pre-incorporation acts, signing of incorporation document and legal representation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in country of origin (or Colombian Notaría if signed in Colombia)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport / national ID of each shareholder, legal representative, and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary or consular authority of the holder's nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration for AML/CFT clearance of each founding shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign or Colombian regulated banking institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on notarized signature of bank officer (or direct bank confirmation to Colombian counsel)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution or corporate consent of foreign corporate shareholder authorizing the Colombian S.A.S. incorporation and UBO declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague states)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, legal representatives, officers, and each 5%+ ultimate beneficial owner against: OFAC SDN List and US sectoral sanctions; UN Security Council Consolidated List (1267/1988/2231); EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; UK OFSI Consolidated List; Colombian 'listas restrictivas' under Decree 1674 of 2016, including the Criminal Assets List (Lista de Lavadores de Activos) and the structured sanctions list published by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; PEP identification per SAGRILAFT methodology (Circular 100-000013 of 2022). For an App-Store freemium utility with Apple IAP and Google Play Billing payment rails, additional screening against OFAC Cuba, Iran, Syria, North Korea, and Crimea sanctions is required; automated World-Check/Refinitiv or equivalent screening with quarterly re-sweep is the accepted standard for low-risk ISIC 6201 firms.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Único Empresarial y Social, accessed via the local Cámara de Comercio portal (e.g., www.ccb.org.co for Bogotá D.C.)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Spanish or use Latin-alphabet transliteration; foreign-script names are inadmissible without a certified Latin-alphabet equivalency; the denomination must be followed by the mandatory suffix 'S.A.S.'; names must not be identical or 'semejantes' (confusingly similar) to any existing RUES-registered name; a 'Certificado de Homonimia' issued by the Chamber of Commerce is a prerequisite for registration.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Bancario, Financiera, Seguros, Aseguradora, Fondo de Inversión, Bolsa, Valores, Sociedad Administradora de Fondos, Trust, Leasing, Factoring, Microcrédito (require prior license from Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
Cooperativa, Mutual, Fondos de Empleados (require Superintendencia de Economía Solidaria authorization)
Presidencia, Ministerio, Gobernación, Alcaldía, Estado, Nacional, Banco de la República, DIAN, Fiscalía (any token implying public authority)
ONU, OEA, Unión Europea, Unicef, Cruz Roja (international organization names, absolutely prohibited)
Names identical or confusingly similar to existing registered companies or trademarks in RUES
Words contrary to public order, morality, or Colombian constitutional principles
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The homonimia certificate expires 30 calendar days after issuance and cannot be administratively extended; the applicant must file a fresh search and reservation request at the Chamber of Commerce if registration does not occur within the window. Upon rejection due to similarity, the applicant may file a 'derecho de petición' under Law 1755/2015 before the issuing Chamber of Commerce within 5 business days, attaching trademark registration or authorization from the conflicting holder; if rejected again, the applicant may escalate to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) via its electronic administrative procedure portal. Rejections based on financial-sector sensitive tokens require a favorable prior opinion (certificado de autorización) from Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia before re-filing; ministerial or governmental tokens cannot be cured and require selecting an alternative name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are accepted de facto for low-risk digital/software businesses: the S.A.S. must register in RUES a 'domicilio social' consisting of a physical Colombian address capable of valid service of process (notificación judicial); a P.O. box alone is inadmissible. Coworking or registered-agent addresses (including the office of the Colombian legal counsel) satisfy the requirement if the legal representative promptly receives official correspondence; for ISIC 6201 app developers with no physical premises, this standard is commercially compliant, but the Chamber of Commerce may request proof of the landlord's consent to statutory mail handling.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated <3% annual probability). DIAN and SIC primarily verify software/technology firms through documentary requirements (certificate of existence, RUBF filing, electronic invoicing, tax domicile) rather than unannounced on-site visits; inspection risk rises to moderate only upon missed RUBF deadlines, tax irregularities, or CIIU code mismatches, each of which could trigger a verification letter requiring response within 10 business days.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Stage 1 cross-border due diligence, UBO piercing, PEP/sanctions screening and AML/CFT risk assessment (SAGRILAFT-oriented)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External law firm / AML compliance counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed engagement fee for low-risk software S.A.S. pre-incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. incorporation document (documento privado), bylaws, shareholder register, and UBO matrix
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed drafting fee under Law 1258/2008

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization of 3-5 foreign corporate documents (good standing, POA, board resolution, passport copies)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority of origin (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State or EU Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory Hague Convention fee (approx. USD 15-25 per document)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation (traducción oficial) of apostilled foreign documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator (traductor oficial) recognized by Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs / judicial authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market per-page tariff (approx. USD 25-40 per page)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization / notarial authentication of signatures on the S.A.S. private incorporation document
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian Notaría (e.g., Notaría del Círculo de Bogotá)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on low asset bracket (approx. COP 110,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory 0.7% of subscribed capital where no real-property contribution (Art. 226, Law 223 of 1995); minimum assessment

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee per issued certificate (approx. COP 35,000)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Arts. 4-5 and 17-19; Código de Comercio Arts. 110-125; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Book 2, Chapter 2 (RUES); Ley 222 de 1995.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); inspection and surveillance by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation deed) registered in the Mercantile Registry; a public deed (escritura pública) is required only if real property is contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; shareholders freely set the capital. The subscribed capital must be fully paid within a maximum term of two (2) years (Ley 1258/2008, Art. 5). No escrow account is required for a software/app S.A.S.; monetary contributions are deposited in the company's bank account.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION - [NAME] S.A.S. The incorporators and shareholders, convened in Bogotá D.C. on [DATE], resolved unanimously: 1. Share subscription: the subscribed capital is ratified, payable within the statutory two-year term, with the initial installment transferred to the company's bank account. 2. Registered office: the corporate domicile is fixed at [street address], Bogotá D.C.; all corporate books and notices shall be kept at that address. 3. Officers: [Legal Rep Name], identified with C.C. [No.], is appointed Legal Representative with full powers under Ley 1258/2008; [Accountant Name], T.P. [No.], is appointed as the fiscal-year accountant. 4. Authorizations: the Legal Representative is empowered to file the RUT, register the corporate books with the Chamber of Commerce, and complete all follow-up formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RUES / Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce offices)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name search request (certificado de homonimia) at any Chamber of Commerce or online through RUES to verify that the proposed corporate name is not identical or confusingly similar to existing registrations. Upon clearance, the name is reserved for a maximum of 30 working days. Include 2-3 alternate name options in the submission.
required_dossiers: Copy of incorporators' identity documents (cédula/passport)
RUT (tax registration) of each incorporator, if available
Completed name search form (formato de consulta de homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If homonymy is found, submit alternative names in a written amendment; the reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Authentication of the Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (optional) or Cámara de Comercio (signature acknowledgment procedure)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the S.A.S. incorporation document (bylaws) containing the corporate purpose, capital subscription, board composition, and legal representative powers. Sign the document before a notary or appear at the Chamber of Commerce for acknowledgment of signatures and content (reconocimiento de firma y contenido). Ensure compliance with Ley 1258/2008 and the RUES template.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws (documento privado de constitución)
Shareholders' identity documents
Capital subscription schedule and payment proof, if applicable
Name reservation certificate, if obtained
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber identifies drafting errors, file a corrective addendum or a new document; notarization is not mandatory unless real property is contributed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration and Filing with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio via RUES (Ventanilla Única Empresarial); DIAN for integrated tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation document electronically through the RUES platform together with the completed RUE form, RUT pre-registration, and payment of the mercantile registration fee. The Chamber verifies legality, enters the company in the Mercantile Registry, and issues the certificate of existence and legal representation (certificado de existencia y representación legal).
required_dossiers: RUES incorporation settlement form (planilla de matrícula)
Incorporation document with acknowledgments
Identification of the legal representative
Proof of payment of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues an observation (observación), correct the discrepancies within 10 business days by filing a subsanación memorandum through RUES; avoid resubmitting a full new dossier unless specifically required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Corporate Books (Libros de Comercio)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio - Registro de Libros
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before use, present the company's statutory minute book (libro de actas) and shareholder registry book (libro de registro de accionistas) to the Chamber of Commerce for stamping and registration. The books must be bound or presented through the Chamber's digital corporate books system.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
Tax ID (NIT) documentation
Corporate books to be stamped (physical or digital)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late-registered books are admissible after payment of the applicable late fee under the Chamber of Commerce tariff; use of unregistered books may trigger sanctions by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax ID (RUT/NIT), Digital Signature and Electronic Invoicing Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, confirm the provisional NIT assigned through RUES, activate the RUT online on the DIAN portal using the legal representative's digital certificate, and request authorization for electronic invoicing (habilitación de facturación electrónica). Obtain the digital signature certificate from a certified certification authority if not already held.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation issued within the last 90 days
Legal representative's identity document and digital certificate
RUT form (Formulario de Registro Tributario)
Proof of registered address (lease agreement or utility bill)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT request is rejected, file a corrective update (actualización del RUT) on the DIAN website within the response period; request reclassification to the correct economic activity code (ISIC 6201) if misclassified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Operational Start-Up: Social Security, Bank Account and Municipal Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Social security system (EPS/ARP/Pension), financial entity, and municipal planning office (Curaduría Urbana)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company and the legal representative with the employer social security system, open the corporate bank account in the company's name, and obtain the land-use certificate (certificado de uso de suelo) for the registered office. If the office is leased, request the landlord's documents and the fire safety certificate of the building.
required_dossiers: NIT and certificate of existence and legal representation
Bylaws and legal representative appointment minutes
Lease agreement or property title
Fire safety certificate (Certificado de Bomberos) of the premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the land-use certificate is adverse, relocate the registered office to a compatible zoning area and re-register the address change via RUES within the prescribed term.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board applies to software development; premises are regulated by the Municipal Planning Office (Secretaría de Planeación / Curaduría Urbana).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No specific operating license applies to ISIC 6201 (mobile application and software engineering); a Certificado de Uso de Suelo is required only for the physical office, not for the digital service activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the municipal environmental authority (Secretaría de Ambiente / CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category IV - no EIA report required): software engineering and administrative offices generate no significant environmental impact; only a simplified environmental registration may be required for small offices with solid waste generation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial wastewater discharges; compliance with municipal sewerage standards under Decreto 3930 de 2010, as amended; electronic waste (RAEE) must be handled through certified take-back programs under Resolución 1512 de 2010; VOC and noise thresholds not applicable to office-based software operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire and human safety certificate) for the office premises; occupational health and safety management system (SG-SST) per Resolución 0312 de 2019; building structural load and seismic safety verification by the property administrator for multistory office buildings.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - Colombia's national tax and customs authority; official portal: https://www.dian.gov.co (MUISCA virtual taxpayer service)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Non-resident entities obtain a Colombian NIT by registering through the Unique Tax Registry (RUT) at DIAN, either directly with an appointed legal representative and evidenced by a notarized power of attorney, or through a registered agent. For an S.A.S., incorporation before a Chamber of Commerce automatically creates the obligation to obtain the NIT; after incorporation the company must enroll in the RUT and select the VAT 'Responsable' regime. Foreign digital service providers without local domicile must also designate a local agent, obtain a provisional NIT, and register as a digital services seller for VAT in the RUT before transacting.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or transparent entity election is available for S.A.S. in Colombia. The company is a corporate income taxpayer (35% CIT) on worldwide income. Elections that are available in practice include: (1) applying for the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' if taxable gross income limits are met, (2) requesting Free Trade Zone / 'Zona Franca' certification for preferential 20% CIT on export operations, and (3) registering as an exporter for VAT zero-rating. Under Colombia's hybrid mismatch rules (Art. 124-1 ff. ET), taxpayer choices are limited to anti-abuse adjustments; there is no statutory unilateral pass-through election for an S.A.S.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT - Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA) on goods, services, and intangible/digital services
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For incorporated entities (S.A.S.), registration with DIAN is compulsory from incorporation regardless of revenue; for natural persons and other obliged parties, VAT registration is required when taxable gross income exceeds 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 160,000,000 in 2025). Non-resident digital service providers supplying digital services to Colombian residents have no economic threshold; the VAT obligation arises on the first supply, requiring RUT/NIT registration and agent appointment.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: DIAN mandates fully electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta) for all VAT-responsible parties, with real-time XML submission through the DIAN web service or an authorized technology provider. Each invoice must receive a DIAN-issued CUFE (Código Único de Facturación) or QR validation before delivery; daily/monthly transmission to MUISCA is mandatory; export invoices must be stamped as zero-rated and linked to supporting documentation. Electronic authorization is effectively real-time, and no paper-only invoice is recognized for VAT deductions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services from Colombia are eligible for 0% VAT. For services, the Colombian provider must (i) be registered as an export services provider in the RUT, (ii) be engaged by a non-resident person or a resident whose foreign operations use the service exclusively abroad, (iii) prove the service is used/exploited outside Colombia, and (iv) receive payment through foreign exchange channels. Mobile utility app license sales transacted through Apple/Google app stores are treated as export services only if the end user is abroad and the app is downloaded/used outside Colombia; sales to Colombian users via app store payment rails remain subject to 19% VAT collected by the platform or by the local company if responsible.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX) filed electronically through MUISCA
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Foreign Currency Declaración de Cambio form and Inward Remittance Certificate proving FX settlement
Certificate of Origin (where a preferential tariff/zero-rating is claimed)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN audits export zero-rating claims with a strict documentary and FX-trail burden. Missing the 180-day repatriation deadline, incomplete DEX/BL/invoice chains, or sham app-store distribution arrangements cause immediate zero-rating rejection, retroactive VAT at 19% with default interest (monthly interest approximating 1.5x the benchmark lending rate), fines up to 200% of the omitted tax for fraudulent invoices, potential criminal liability for customs false declarations (Criminal Code Arts. 286-288), and clawback of input VAT credits previously refunded based on the zero-rated export. Penalties are not waivable if the exporter fails to prove actual foreign use and repatriation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), with supervisory and enforcement coordination by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and the tax and customs authority DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales). The foreign exchange control framework derives from the 1993 Estatuto Cambiario (Decree 1735/1993), Resolution No. 8 of 2000 of the Banco de la República Board of Directors, and the Banco de la República External Circular DTE-018 of 2018, as amended by Resolution No. 3 of 2020.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed-floating exchange-rate regime with partial capital controls. Current-account flows (software-export fees, app-store royalties, technical service revenue, operating costs) are freely convertible through authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries without prior central-bank licensing, but each receipt and payment must be channeled (canalizado) through an authorized bank and evidenced by a Declaración de Cambio. Capital-account flows are registrable: non-resident equity contributions and cross-border loans must be registered with Banco de la República and quoted with the prescribed purpose codes (4010 for direct investment, 4400 for external credit). Dividend repatriation is not exchange-control constrained for distributable accounting profits, provided the foreign investment registration is active and the applicable non-resident dividend withholding taxes (20% base plus 10% surtax on remittable profits) are settled. Practical convertibility hurdles relate to documentary minimums, multi-day FX desk processing, and monthly reconciliation reporting rather than to outright convertibility bans.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from cross-border digital services (including Apple App Store and Google Play developer settlements under ISIC 6201) must be channeled through the Colombian foreign-exchange market. Under the current regime, service-export collections must be deposited into a local foreign-currency account at an authorized intermediary bank or monetized into COP within six (6) months from the date the payment becomes due and collectible, per Resolution No. 3 of 2020 and Decree 1364 of 2020 transitional provisions. The effective surrender ratio is 100% of the export collection value; no general exemption applies to mobile-utility app revenue, although de minimis operations below the approximate USD 10,000 per-transaction threshold may be excluded. Execution requires the commercial invoice, the software license or SaaS distribution contract, the Apple/Google merchant agreements, and the relevant DIAN documentation; the bank records the operation through Declaración de Cambio Form 1 or Form 14 and reconciles it with Banco de la República trade data.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP current account with integrated foreign-exchange channeling and foreign-currency deposit sub-account)
Operational Account (current account with FX desk and declaration-code handling for SAS export receipts)
Operational Account / Capital Escrow Account (equity subscription and intercompany-loan clearing)
Operational Account (USD local foreign-currency account plus COP account)
Operational Account / Corporativo FX Account (cross-border inflows and hedging instruments)
Operational Account (SAS checking with trade-finance options)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium as an ancillary collection or disbursement workaround, but Low as the principal operating account. Non-resident digital EMIs (Payoneer Business, Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury) are not licensed by the SFC as authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries and cannot perform the mandatory canalización of export proceeds. Legitimate utility is limited to receiving Apple/Google payouts before onward SWIFT transfer to a local authorized bank within the six-month window, or to paying low-value international suppliers. Sustained use creates reporting failure risk: foreign accounts must be declared to Banco de la República and DIAN, each repatriation requires a Declaración de Cambio, and irregular EMI flows increase local-bank AML scrutiny. The compliant structure is direct settlement of app-store proceeds into the local bank's foreign-currency account, with any offshore EMI used only through a purpose-documented treasury rationale.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory rule mandates physical appearance for every incorporator or director; in practice, the legal representative or a holder of a durable special power of attorney must attend at least one onboarding interview. For a 100% non-resident-owned SAS, SFC enhanced-due-diligence expectations typically require the ultimate beneficial owner to appear at a branch or complete a bank-approved secure video-verification call with liveness, geolocation, and notarized or apostilled identity documents. Non-resident directors can open without traveling if the bank receives an apostilled corporate existence certificate, an apostilled board resolution granting account-opening powers, certified passports, the RUT (Registro Único Tributario), and a power of attorney for a local signatory. Bancolombia and BBVA have the most mature digital onboarding flows; an onboarding cycle of three to six weeks is realistic given the non-resident ownership review.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ultimate beneficial ownership cascade (failure to disclose natural persons holding or controlling more than 5% of the SAS).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full UBO chain documentation: certified shareholder registry (libro de registro de accionistas), apostilled subscription and share certificate records, sworn UBO declaration compliant with Resolution 164 of 2020 and Law 2155 of 2021, plus an organizational chart identifying every natural person with control or greater-than-5% interest.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and PEP screening hits on non-resident shareholders, directors, or payment hub counterparties (Apple/Google settlement entities).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent screening certificate against OFAC, UN, EU, UK, and Colombian LA/FT restrictive lists issued by an external compliance provider; signed PEP declarations from each director and shareholder; and an enhanced source-of-funds narrative explaining the founders' prior software and IT revenue.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unsubstantiated provenance of inbound share-capital wiring (the SAS has no statutory minimum capital, but deposits must still be explained).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six-month bank statements from the remitting shareholder; capitalization minutes (acta de aporte); signed subscription resolutions; remitter tax identification and sector declaration; and a source-of-wealth statement connecting the funds to legitimate app, software, or professional income.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Typology mismatch between a low-capital SAS and projected large recurring Apple/Google USD payouts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apple Developer Program registration and App Store Connect financial reports; Google Play Console revenue statements; DIAN electronic invoices (factura electrónica); technical service agreements for the mobile utility app; and the ISIC 6201 business description filed with the Cámara de Comercio, supported by a revenue ledger reflecting the freemium model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected cross-border flows to high-risk tax or secrecy jurisdictions or to offshore banking partners not recognized by the SFC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed commitment that 100% of export collections will be channeled through the local authorized bank within the statutory window; declaration that no signatory authority exists over offshore accounts; engagement of a local AML compliance officer; adoption of an SFC-consistent SARLAFT monitoring manual; and monthly submission of FX declaration copies to the bank's compliance unit.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route every non-COP inflow exclusively through an authorized local intermediary. Equity injection: the non-resident shareholder wires via SWIFT MT103 to the SAS's COP current account quoting declaration code 4010 (inversión extranjera directa de capital); the receiving bank issues Form 14 Declaración de Cambio, and registration with the Banco de la República foreign-investment registry must occur before any dividend flow (typically within 90 days). Intercompany credit: use code 4400 (crédito externo), execute an arm's-length cross-border loan agreement, register the loan with Banco de la República, and address the Colombian thin-capitalization rule (interest deduction capped at 20% of EBITDA) with pricing documentation. Both flows require the apostilled shareholder resolution, supporting invoices or memoranda, and the valid RUT; no unlicensed payment institution may substitute for an authorized Colombian bank in receiving these funds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 wire transfers for low-value service disbursements (outsourced developers, cloud hosting, digital advertising), with the local bank capturing the purpose code and issuing the mandatory Declaración de Cambio. Use commercial letters of credit (irrevocable, payable at sight or deferred) for high-value enterprise technology purchases requiring document-based settlement security. Use the authorized bank's FX desk for periodic USD purchases when export FX balances are insufficient. Each outbound transfer must be supported by the underlying contract and commercial invoice and, where withholding applies, by DIAN form 240 evidence of retention at source. Bank-hosted batch-payment and SWIFT connectivity tools are preferred over third-party processors because local FX reporting obligations attach to the initiating resident entity.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/COP forwards (forwards de cumplimiento financiero and delivery forwards) contracted with an authorized local intermediary, limited to documented underlying trade exposure.
Onshore non-deliverable USD/COP forwards (NDFs) settled in COP with an authorized Colombian financial institution.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCIRS) between USD and COP tied to external debt or significant intercompany liquidity exposure.
USD/COP foreign-exchange swaps and outright call and put options acquired for trade remittance and receivable hedging.

Offshore NDFs against COP contractually permissible to the extent the underlying exposure is registered with Banco de la República, the hedge is documented, and the local books record the derivative in accordance with SFC Chapter 18 requirements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) where the S.A.S. registered office is domiciled
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each calendar year; non-extendable renewal window from 1 January to 31 March.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a 10% surcharge on the applicable registration tariff; failure to renew for more than one annual cycle enables the Chamber to cancel the commercial registry (administrative strike-off) after formal notification, extinguishing good standing and trading capacity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due in April–May of the year immediately following the tax year, per the DIAN annual calendar assigned by the last two digits of the company’s NIT; no fixed universal date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-filing penalty of 5% per month (or fraction of month) of the income tax liability, capped at 100% of the tax, plus moratory interest; non-filing permits DIAN to issue an official tax assessment with additional penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Deposit (Depósito de Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders’ meeting (approval); local Cámara de Comercio (deposit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve 31 December financial statements by 31 March; deposit at the Chamber within 30 days after approval, normally by 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-deposit is a mercantile law violation that may be fined by the Superintendencia de Sociedades and may prevent issuance of good-standing certificates; chronic non-compliance may trigger administrative scrutiny of the S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Update (Actualización del Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Cámara de Comercio (UBO module of the commercial registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the commercial-registry renewal, by 31 March each year; any UBO-relevant share transfer during the year must be reported within 10 business days of the transaction.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or untimely UBO information is sanctionable under Colombia’s AML/CFT rules and Superintendencia de Sociedades enforcement, with fines and, in severe cases, suspension of the company’s registration; renewal and share-transfer procedures are blocked until compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: For an S.A.S., statutory audit by a certified public accountant (revisor fiscal) is required when the company, during the immediately preceding fiscal year, has gross income exceeding 10,000 SMMLV (≈ COP 13.0 billion / USD 3.2 million for 2024) or assets exceeding 5,000 SMMLV (≈ COP 6.5 billion / USD 1.6 million for 2024), or when the Superintendencia de Sociedades orders it. Below these thresholds, no statutory auditor is mandatory, but shareholder agreements may require one.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (CFRS) – IFRS as adopted by Colombia under Law 1314/2009 and Decreto 2420/2015 (amended by Decreto 2496/2015 and subsequent updates); an S.A.S. app developer is typically in Group 2 (IFRS for SMEs) absent public-interest conditions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each share transfer is recorded in the shareholder register on execution; the ultimate beneficial owner (any natural person with >10% direct/indirect capital or control) is disclosed and confirmed annually through the Chamber UBO form as part of the 31 March renewal. A transfer that changes UBO data must be presented to the Chamber within 10 business days, and the annual confirmation must reflect the updated UBO list as of 31 December.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300–900 per year for registered-office/agent services with the Chamber of Commerce
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800–4,200 per year when the revisor fiscal mandate is triggered; nil below the statutory threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 35% headline; 100% exempt income (renta exenta) on exported software services under Art. 235-1(3) E.T., regulated by Decree 141 of 2021, where the S.A.S. has real economic substance, the services are marketed/used outside Colombia and the electronic export validation (Form 370) is performed; foreign-user app-store revenue can therefore be taxed at an effective 0%. No other permanent CIT relief applies.
